name: alert-square-dashed
description: A dashed square containing an exclamation mark.
useCase: Show a warning on a draft or pending item.
misuse: Describe the actual status in text; a dashed border alone does not define it.

16.reason: The full dashed frame remains unchanged; complete status marks and open gaps stay clear at text size.

24.reason: The full frame and complete status marks retain the same centered layout with larger clear gaps.
